blocks.text: Read the chapter with this setting in view: The Masoretic Psalter contains 150 psalms arranged in five books, with doxological boundaries after Psalms 41, 72, 89, and 106 and a final crescendo of praise in Psalms 146-150. It gives a starting point for following the chapter's own movement. The chapter itself should determine how far the point is taken. The evidence leaves some details unresolved.
